tested:
Bare product name from image-manager/detector.py's documented "vSRX (legacy)
vsrx-" naming convention (e.g. image name "vsrx", version "12.1X47-D20.7").
get_profile()'s prefix/substring match only ever tests whether a PROFILES key
is a prefix of, or substring within, the normalized image name - never the
reverse - so a short bare name like "vsrx" could never match the longer
"juniper-vsrx"/"vsrxng"/"juniper-vsrxng" keys above and silently fell through
to GENERIC_KVM_PROFILE (512MB/1cpu/e1000/120s timeout), reproducing the exact
NPX device-audit boot-timeout failure. Root cause found 2026-07-18 tracing
device 74441580-c55a-425f-9485-aa2ec7a931c8 ("vsrx" / 12.1X47-D20.7): its
stored hardware_defaults.profile_key was "generic:vsrx", proving the fallback.
This explicit alias makes the (already-defined, already-correct-once-fixed)
"juniper-vsrx" profile reachable for that exact registration shape.
